-- The installation's roles and schemas (identity-tenancy contract).
--   backbone_owner     owns every store and schema; never logs in. Owning a store gives it no way
--                      round the storage rules: row-level security is forced and triggers refuse.
--   backbone_gov       owns the crossings (SECURITY DEFINER, pinned search_path). It reaches the
--                      tenant stores under the same walls as the session, and never the accounts.
--   backbone_app       the service. It reads the tenant stores it is granted, writes nothing
--                      directly, executes the published crossings and reaches the accounts.
--   backbone_operator  the installation's operator: creates workspaces through operator.* only.
-- None of them is a superuser or may bypass row-level security. Passwords are set by whoever
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'backbone_owner') THEN
CREATE ROLE backbone_owner NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE;
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'backbone_gov') THEN
CREATE ROLE backbone_gov NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE;
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'backbone_app') THEN
CREATE ROLE backbone_app LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE;
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'backbone_operator') THEN
CREATE ROLE backbone_operator LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE;
-- Credentials are sent as bind parameters; do not put bind values in PostgreSQL logs.
REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
CREATE SCHEMA app AUTHORIZATION backbone_owner;      -- tenant stores, every one walled
CREATE SCHEMA auth AUTHORIZATION backbone_owner;     -- accounts: the service's alone
CREATE SCHEMA ops AUTHORIZATION backbone_owner;      -- queues, keys, migrations: crossings only
CREATE SCHEMA sec AUTHORIZATION backbone_owner;      -- session identity and the policy helpers
CREATE SCHEMA gov AUTHORIZATION backbone_gov;        -- the published crossings (internal ones start with _)
CREATE SCHEMA operator AUTHORIZATION backbone_gov;   -- the operator's crossings
CREATE SCHEMA crypto AUTHORIZATION backbone_owner;   -- pgcrypto, for keyed digests
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto WITH SCHEMA crypto;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA sec TO backbone_gov;
GRANT CREATE ON SCHEMA sec TO backbone_gov;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA app, ops, crypto TO backbone_gov;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA app, sec, gov, auth TO backbone_app;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA operator TO backbone_operator;
-- No function in a product schema is executable by PUBLIC, including functions created later by
-- the roles that own those schemas.
REVOKE EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA crypto FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA crypto TO backbone_gov;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE backbone_owner REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS FROM PUBLIC;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE backbone_gov REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS FROM PUBLIC;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS FROM PUBLIC;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE backbone_owner GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS TO backbone_gov;
-- The person on whose behalf the session acts: a run's mandate beneficiary, a person themself, an
-- agent's owner. The system principal and a worker act for nobody.
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
JOIN app.mandates m ON m.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND m.id = r.mandate_id
WHERE r.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND r.id = sec.current_run())
SELECT CASE p.kind WHEN 'person' THEN p.id WHEN 'agent' THEN o.id END
LEFT JOIN app.principals o ON o.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND o.id = p.owner_id AND o.kind = 'person'
WHERE p.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND p.id = sec.current_principal())
-- The gateway's hash of an effect's arguments: SHA-256 of the canonical text of the jsonb value
-- (keys ordered as jsonb orders them), as lowercase hex. A checker approves exactly this hash.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.args_hash(p_args jsonb) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path = pg_catalog
-- The kernel's attenuate: exactly what was requested and what the parent holds.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.attenuate(parent jsonb, requested jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path = pg_catalog
WHEN parent -> 'budget' ->> k IS NULL THEN requested -> 'budget' -> k
WHEN requested -> 'budget' ->> k IS NULL THEN parent -> 'budget' -> k
-- A knowledge candidate is seen by the workspace's people and by verifiers; one kept for its person
-- (proposed by work marked both ways) only by that person, its proposer and the verifier.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.candidate_visible(p_candidate uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
WHERE c.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND c.id = p_candidate
-- Whether `p_checker` may check `p_proposer`'s proposal. Strictly: from outside every delegation
-- tree the proposer takes part in, people included. Leniently: anyone but the proposer itself and
CREATE FUNCTION sec.checker_independent(p_workspace uuid, p_proposer uuid, p_checker uuid, p_strict boolean) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT p_checker IS NOT NULL AND p_checker <> p_proposer AND CASE
WHEN p_strict THEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM sec.delegation_tree(p_workspace, p_proposer) t WHERE t = p_checker)
WHERE workspace_id = p_workspace AND id = p_checker AND kind = 'agent' AND owner_id = p_proposer)

-- is not held: the principal the session also names is then ignored. Otherwise the named principal,
-- if it is an active principal of the session's workspace.
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
WHEN sec.names_run() THEN (SELECT r.agent_id FROM app.runs r WHERE r.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND r.id = sec.current_run())

LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog

LANGUAGE sql STABLE PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path = pg_catalog

-- Every principal in the delegation trees the principal takes part in: the trees of every mandate
-- that names it (as issuer, subject or beneficiary), from their roots down, plus the owner of an
-- agent and the agents a person owns. Read under the wall of `p_workspace`.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.delegation_tree(p_workspace uuid, p_principal uuid) RETURNS SETOF uuid
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT m.id, m.parent_id FROM app.mandates m
WHERE m.workspace_id = p_workspace AND p_principal IN (m.issuer_id, m.subject_id, m.on_behalf_of_id)
SELECT m.id, m.parent_id FROM app.mandates m JOIN up ON m.workspace_id = p_workspace AND m.id = up.parent_id
SELECT id FROM up WHERE parent_id IS NULL
SELECT m.id FROM app.mandates m JOIN down ON m.workspace_id = p_workspace AND m.parent_id = down.id
SELECT unnest(ARRAY[m.issuer_id, m.subject_id, m.on_behalf_of_id]) AS principal
FROM app.mandates m JOIN down ON m.workspace_id = p_workspace AND m.id = down.id
UNION SELECT owner_id FROM app.principals WHERE workspace_id = p_workspace AND id = p_principal AND kind = 'agent'
UNION SELECT id FROM app.principals WHERE workspace_id = p_workspace AND owner_id = p_principal AND kind = 'agent'
SELECT DISTINCT principal FROM named WHERE principal IS NOT NULL
-- A keyed digest of words someone wrote, under the session workspace's own key (kept in ops, which
-- the service cannot read). The ledger records this in place of the words: whoever has the words
-- cannot test them against the ledger by hashing them, and another workspace digests them apart.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.digest(p_words text) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT CASE WHEN p_words IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
(SELECT digest_key FROM ops.workspace_keys WHERE workspace_id = sec.current_workspace()), 'sha256'), 'hex')
-- The effect lifecycle, as the kernel's EFFECT_TRANSITIONS states it.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.effect_transition_allowed(p_from text, p_to text) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path = pg_catalog
-- An effect is seen by the system principal, by the person it is for, by a verifier asked about it,
-- and by whoever sees its task — unless its run kept its work (it read untrusted content and private
-- material from beyond its conversation): then only by its person and its decider. An undo is seen
CREATE FUNCTION sec.effect_visible(p_effect uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
WHERE e.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND e.id = p_effect
OR (NOT e.kept AND e.task_id IS NOT NULL AND sec.task_visible(e.task_id))
OR (e.undo_of IS NOT NULL AND sec.effect_visible(e.undo_of))
WHERE d.workspace_id = e.workspace_id AND d.id = e.decision_id
-- A recorded source is seen by whoever sees the task or run it was recorded for; one recorded for
CREATE FUNCTION sec.episode_visible(p_task uuid, p_run uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT (p_task IS NULL OR sec.task_visible(p_task)) AND (p_run IS NULL OR sec.run_visible(p_run))
-- An owner or an admin of the session's workspace.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.is_admin(p_principal uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = pg_catalog
-- One of the workspace's verifier agents.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.is_verifier(p_principal uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT FROM app.principals WHERE workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND id = p_principal
AND kind = 'agent' AND agent_role = 'verifier' AND status = 'active')

LANGUAGE sql STABLE PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path = pg_catalog
AS $$ SELECT nullif(current_setting('backbone.run', true), '') IS NOT NULL $$;

CREATE FUNCTION sec.piece_binding(p_piece uuid) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = pg_catalog
WHEN p.id IS NULL OR p.unregistered_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'not_registered'
FROM app.workspaces w LEFT JOIN app.pieces p ON p.workspace_id = w.id AND p.id = p_piece

CREATE FUNCTION sec.principal_kind(p_principal uuid) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
AS $$ SELECT kind FROM app.principals WHERE workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND id = p_principal $$;

CREATE FUNCTION sec.role_of(p_principal uuid) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
WHERE workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND id = p_principal AND kind = 'person' AND status = 'active'

p_external boolean, p_outbound_fixed boolean DEFAULT false

CREATE FUNCTION sec.run_visible(p_run uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT FROM app.runs r WHERE r.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND r.id = p_run AND sec.task_visible(r.task_id))
-- A session that names nobody: no workspace, no principal, no run. Crossings that choose a workspace
-- for themselves (queues, invitations, the first workspace) start only from one.
LANGUAGE sql STABLE PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path = pg_catalog
-- True when a set-spec covers one identifier.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.set_covers(spec jsonb, id text) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path = pg_catalog
AS $$ SELECT spec = '"*"' OR spec ? id $$;
-- What two set-specs both cover ('*' is everything the other covers), sorted and without repeats.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.set_intersect(a jsonb, b jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x COLLATE "C") FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT x FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN a = '"*"' THEN b ELSE a END) x
WHERE (CASE WHEN a = '"*"' THEN a ELSE b END) = '"*"'
OR (CASE WHEN a = '"*"' THEN a ELSE b END) ? x) d
-- True when the set-spec `child` covers nothing that `parent` does not.
CREATE FUNCTION sec.set_within(child jsonb, parent jsonb) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE SET search_path = pg_catalog
OR (child <> '"*"' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(child) x WHERE NOT parent ? x))

RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: memory changes only by being forgotten';
IF NEW.forgotten_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.content <> '' THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: forgetting erases the content';
-- A registration's declaration never changes, and its ceiling is the highest class it declares. It
-- ends once, and is never deleted: runs bound to it keep pointing at what was registered.
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: piece registrations are never deleted';
NEW.effect_ceiling := coalesce((SELECT max(c) FROM unnest(NEW.effect_classes) c), 0);

RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: an unregistered piece stays unregistered';
IF (NEW.id, NEW.workspace_id, NEW.piece, NEW.kind, NEW.version, NEW.digest, NEW.planes, NEW.operations, NEW.effect_classes,
NEW.effect_ceiling, NEW.network, NEW.secrets, NEW.manifest, NEW.registered_by, NEW.registered_at)
(OLD.id, OLD.workspace_id, OLD.piece, OLD.kind, OLD.version, OLD.digest, OLD.planes, OLD.operations, OLD.effect_classes,
OLD.effect_ceiling, OLD.network, OLD.secrets, OLD.manifest, OLD.registered_by, OLD.registered_at) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: a registered piece''s declaration never changes; register the new one';
-- A principal keeps its workspace, kind and owner; its bound account never changes once bound.
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: principals are never deleted';
IF OLD.user_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.user_id THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: a person''s bound account never changes';
IF (NEW.id, NEW.workspace_id, NEW.kind, NEW.agent_role, NEW.owner_id, NEW.created_at)
IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.id, OLD.workspace_id, OLD.kind, OLD.agent_role, OLD.owner_id, OLD.created_at) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: a principal keeps its workspace, kind and owner';
-- No store is ever truncated, not even by the role that owns it.
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: %.% is never truncated', TG_TABLE_SCHEMA, TG_TABLE_NAME;
-- A run's marks only rise, and why a mark was set never changes once set. Its identity and
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: runs are never deleted';
IF (OLD.tainted_untrusted AND NOT NEW.tainted_untrusted) OR (OLD.tainted_sensitive AND NOT NEW.tainted_sensitive)
OR (OLD.untrusted_source IS NOT NULL AND NEW.untrusted_source IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.untrusted_source)
OR (OLD.sensitive_source IS NOT NULL AND NEW.sensitive_source IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.sensitive_source)
OR (OLD.elsewhere_source IS NOT NULL AND NEW.elsewhere_source IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.elsewhere_source) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: marks only rise, and why they were set never changes';
IF NEW.task_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.task_id OR NEW.agent_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.agent_id
OR NEW.mandate_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.mandate_id OR NEW.fence < OLD.fence THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: a run keeps its task, agent and mandate, and its fence only rises';
-- A run takes its mandate's carrier (a registered piece, or 'direct') when it is queued, and never
-- changes it. A run under a piece's mandate is bound to that piece (it may name none, and inherits
-- it); a direct mandate never carries a piece's run.
IF (NEW.carrier, NEW.piece_id) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.carrier, OLD.piece_id) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: a run keeps what carries it';
SELECT x.carrier, x.piece_id INTO m FROM app.mandates x WHERE x.workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id AND x.id = NEW.mandate_id;
IF NEW.piece_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.piece_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.piece_id THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'other_piece: the run''s mandate was granted to another piece, or to none';
IF NEW.piece_id IS NOT NULL THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_registered: the piece is not registered in this workspace';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'denied: the piece does not declare this workspace''s plane';
-- A step's input is frozen when written, and a completed step never changes.
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: steps are never deleted';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: a completed step never changes';
IF NEW.input IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.input OR NEW.seq <> OLD.seq OR NEW.run_id <> OLD.run_id
OR NEW.fence <> OLD.fence OR NEW.kind <> OLD.kind OR NEW.title IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.title THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: a step''s input is frozen when it is written';

SELECT ws, ct.id, coalesce(pointer, answer), 'outbound' FROM app.channel_threads ct WHERE ct.workspace_id = ws AND ct.task_id = p_task;
PERFORM gov._append('message.posted', answer::text, jsonb_build_object('task', p_task, 'role', 'agent', 'run', run, 'kept', kept));
-- The system principal begins dispatching an effect it holds the current claim of. Authority is
-- re-read as it is spent: an effect whose mandate expired meanwhile is cancelled and nothing is
-- sent (false). From here the effect can only be observed.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.begin_dispatch(p_effect uuid, p_claim text) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT * INTO e FROM app.effects x WHERE x.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND x.id = p_effect FOR UPDATE;
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such effect in this workspace';
SELECT * INTO q FROM ops.effect_queue x WHERE x.effect_id = p_effect;
IF e.status <> 'claimed' OR q.claim_token IS DISTINCT FROM p_claim OR q.lease_expires_at <= clock_timestamp() THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale: this claim no longer holds the effect';
IF e.mandate_id IS NOT NULL THEN
UPDATE app.effects SET status = 'dispatching', dispatcher_id = sec.current_principal() WHERE workspace_id = e.workspace_id AND id = p_effect;
UPDATE ops.effect_queue x SET due_at = q.lease_expires_at + grace WHERE x.effect_id = p_effect;
PERFORM gov._append('effect.dispatched', p_effect::text, gov._effect_payload(p_effect) || jsonb_build_object('dispatcher', sec.current_principal()));
-- A person binds their sign-in account, once.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.bind_account(p_user text) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
IF p_user IS NULL OR length(p_user) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: an account id is needed';
UPDATE app.principals SET user_id = p_user WHERE workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND id = me;
-- Cancel an effect before its dispatch begins: the person it is for, an owner or admin who sees
-- it, or the system principal. Once dispatch began it is too late: it can only be observed.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.cancel_effect(p_effect uuid, p_reason text) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_identity: the session acts as nobody';
SELECT * INTO e FROM app.effects x WHERE x.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND x.id = p_effect FOR UPDATE;
IF NOT FOUND OR NOT sec.effect_visible(p_effect) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such effect for this session';
IF sec.names_run() OR NOT (me = e.on_behalf_of_id OR me = e.proposer_id OR me = sec.system_principal() OR sec.is_admin(me)) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'role: an effect is cancelled by its person, an admin or the system';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_open: the effect is already settled';
-- An owner or admin changes a person's role. Only an owner makes or unmakes an owner.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.change_role(p_person uuid, p_role text) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such person in this workspace';
IF p_role IS NULL OR p_role NOT IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member', 'guest') THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: a role is owner, admin, member or guest';
IF (was = 'owner' OR p_role = 'owner') AND sec.role_of(me) <> 'owner' THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'role: only an owner makes or unmakes an owner';
UPDATE app.principals SET role = p_role WHERE workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND id = p_person;
PERFORM gov._append('person.role_changed', p_person::text, jsonb_build_object('from', was, 'to', p_role));
-- The system principal claims an allowed effect for dispatch (or one whose last claim lapsed).
-- Nothing else claims: not the proposing agent, not a person. An effect inside its cancellation
-- window waits for the window to end.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.claim_effect(p_effect uuid, p_lease_ms integer) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT * INTO e FROM app.effects x WHERE x.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND x.id = p_effect FOR UPDATE;
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such effect in this workspace';
SELECT * INTO q FROM ops.effect_queue x WHERE x.effect_id = p_effect;
IF e.not_before IS NOT NULL AND e.not_before > clock_timestamp() THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'window: the effect is inside its workspace''s cancellation window';
ELSIF NOT (e.status = 'claimed' AND (q.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR q.lease_expires_at <= clock_timestamp())) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_claimable: the effect is not waiting to be dispatched';
-- A dispatcher takes the next due effect of any workspace, from an empty session, as that
-- workspace's system principal, and leaves the session empty. A dispatching effect whose
-- dispatcher went silent comes back as stale, with its claim, once its lease and the grace window
-- (30 seconds; effect-gateway contract, stale dispatch) have passed: to be inspected and observed, never sent again.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.claim_next_effect(p_worker text, p_lease_ms integer)
RETURNS TABLE (workspace_id uuid, effect_id uuid, claim_token text, stale boolean, system_id uuid)
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
RAISE EXCEPTION 'empty_session_only: the queue is read from a session that names nobody';
IF p_lease_ms IS NULL OR p_lease_ms <= 0 THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: a lease is a positive number of milliseconds';
SELECT * INTO q FROM ops.effect_queue x WHERE x.due_at <= clock_timestamp()
ORDER BY x.due_at, x.enqueued_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
SELECT * INTO e FROM app.effects x WHERE x.workspace_id = q.workspace_id AND x.id = q.effect_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
UPDATE ops.effect_queue x SET due_at = clock_timestamp() + interval '1 second' WHERE x.effect_id = q.effect_id;
ELSIF (e.status = 'allowed' AND (e.not_before IS NULL OR e.not_before <= clock_timestamp()))
RETURN QUERY SELECT q.workspace_id, e.id, v_claim, false, v_system;
UPDATE ops.effect_queue x SET due_at = e.not_before WHERE x.effect_id = q.effect_id;
UPDATE ops.effect_queue x SET due_at = q.lease_expires_at WHERE x.effect_id = q.effect_id;
ELSIF e.status = 'dispatching' AND q.lease_expires_at + grace <= clock_timestamp()
AND (q.stale_handed_until IS NULL OR q.stale_handed_until <= clock_timestamp()) THEN
UPDATE ops.effect_queue x SET stale_handed_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => p_lease_ms / 1000.0),
RETURN QUERY SELECT q.workspace_id, e.id, q.claim_token, true, v_system;
UPDATE ops.effect_queue x SET due_at = greatest(q.lease_expires_at + grace, coalesce(q.stale_handed_until, q.lease_expires_at + grace))
DELETE FROM ops.effect_queue x WHERE x.effect_id = q.effect_id;
-- A worker takes the next claimable run of any workspace, from an empty session, and leaves the
-- session empty again. Runs whose mandate no longer stands are stopped on the way, not handed out.
-- Only runs carried by exactly what the worker runs ('piece' with p_piece, or 'direct') are handed to it.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.claim_next_run(p_worker text, p_lease_ms integer, p_carrier text, p_piece uuid DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS TABLE (workspace_id uuid, run_id uuid, fence bigint, secret text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
wanted text := CASE WHEN p_carrier = 'piece' AND p_piece IS NOT NULL THEN p_piece::text WHEN p_carrier = 'direct' AND p_piece IS NULL THEN 'direct' END;
RAISE EXCEPTION 'empty_session_only: the queue is read from a session that names nobody';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: a worker states what it runs: ''piece'' with a registered piece, or ''direct''';
-- Select without a queue/run lock, bind its workspace for RLS, then lock workspace first.
SELECT x.* INTO q FROM ops.run_queue x
WHERE x.carrier_key = wanted AND x.claimable_after <= clock_timestamp()
PERFORM 1 FROM app.ledger_heads WHERE workspace_id = q.workspace_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
SELECT * INTO r FROM app.runs x WHERE x.workspace_id = q.workspace_id AND x.id = q.run_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
UPDATE ops.run_queue SET claimable_after = clock_timestamp() + interval '1 second' WHERE ops.run_queue.run_id = q.run_id;
DELETE FROM ops.run_queue WHERE ops.run_queue.run_id = q.run_id;
ELSIF r.status = 'waiting' AND NOT r.woken THEN
UPDATE ops.run_queue SET claimable_after = NULL WHERE ops.run_queue.run_id = q.run_id;
ELSIF r.status = 'running' AND r.lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp() THEN
UPDATE ops.run_queue SET claimable_after = r.lease_expires_at WHERE ops.run_queue.run_id = q.run_id;
SELECT * INTO c FROM gov._claim(q.run_id, p_worker, p_lease_ms);
IF c.fence IS NOT NULL THEN
RETURN QUERY SELECT q.workspace_id, q.run_id, c.fence, c.secret;
-- A verifier worker takes the next question of any workspace's verification queue, from an empty
-- session, under a short lease, and leaves the session empty. Escalated, answered or withdrawn
-- questions leave the queue on the way.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.claim_next_verification(p_worker text, p_lease_ms integer)
RETURNS TABLE (workspace_id uuid, decision_id uuid, verifier_id uuid)
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
RAISE EXCEPTION 'empty_session_only: the queue is read from a session that names nobody';
IF p_lease_ms IS NULL OR p_lease_ms <= 0 THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: a lease is a positive number of milliseconds';
SELECT * INTO q FROM ops.verification_queue x WHERE x.available_at <= clock_timestamp() AND NOT (x.decision_id = ANY(held))
ORDER BY x.enqueued_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
SELECT * INTO d FROM app.decisions x WHERE x.workspace_id = q.workspace_id AND x.id = q.decision_id;
IF d.id IS NULL OR d.status <> 'open' OR d.escalated_at IS NOT NULL THEN
DELETE FROM ops.verification_queue x WHERE x.decision_id = q.decision_id;
UPDATE ops.verification_queue x SET available_at = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => p_lease_ms / 1000.0), worker = p_worker
RETURN QUERY SELECT q.workspace_id, q.decision_id, q.verifier_id;
-- A worker process claims a run by its id. Only a worker claims: a session naming a principal or a
-- run is refused. Returns its fence and secret, or no row when its mandate no longer stands (the
-- run is then stopped). The worker states what it runs: 'piece' with the registered piece, or
-- 'direct'. A run is claimed only for exactly what carries it, so a piece never executes a direct
-- run or another piece's (or version's), and a direct worker never executes a piece's.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.claim_run(p_run uuid, p_worker text, p_lease_ms integer, p_carrier text, p_piece uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS TABLE (fence bigint, secret text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_identity: the session names no workspace';
IF nullif(current_setting('backbone.principal', true), '') IS NOT NULL OR sec.names_run() THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'workers_only: runs are claimed by worker processes, not by principals or runs';
IF p_carrier IS NULL OR NOT ((p_carrier = 'piece' AND p_piece IS NOT NULL) OR (p_carrier = 'direct' AND p_piece IS NULL)) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: a worker states what it runs: ''piece'' with a registered piece, or ''direct''';
-- Revocation takes workspace then run; claims must take the same order.
SELECT carrier, piece_id INTO bound FROM app.runs WHERE workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND id = p_run FOR UPDATE;
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such run in this workspace';
IF (bound.carrier, bound.piece_id) IS DISTINCT FROM (p_carrier, p_piece) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'other_piece: the run is carried by something other than what this worker runs';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_claimable: the run is held, finished or stopped';
SELECT * INTO c FROM gov._claim(p_run, p_worker, p_lease_ms);
IF c.fence IS NOT NULL THEN
-- An owner or admin classifies operations in the workspace's catalogue. A change that only raises
-- (a higher class, or external) restricts agents and applies at once. One that lowers is an
-- elevation: in a personal workspace (one root of authority) it applies at once; otherwise it waits
-- for an owner or admin from outside the proposer's delegation tree. Built-in classes never move.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.classify_operations(p_changes jsonb) RETURNS TABLE (change_id uuid, decision_id uuid)
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
IF jsonb_typeof(p_changes) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_changes) = 0 THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: a classification lists its changes';
FOR ch IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_changes) LOOP
IF jsonb_typeof(ch -> 'class') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (ch ->> 'class')::numeric NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
OR coalesce(length(ch ->> 'operation'), 0) = 0 OR jsonb_typeof(ch -> 'external') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean' THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: each change names an operation, a class from 1 to 6 and whether it is external';
SELECT * INTO cur FROM gov._operation_class(ch ->> 'operation', NULL, NULL, NULL);
IF (ch ->> 'class')::smallint < cur.effect_class OR (cur.external AND NOT (ch ->> 'external')::boolean) THEN
INSERT INTO app.operation_changes (workspace_id, id, changes, status, proposed_by)
VALUES (ws, new_id, p_changes, CASE WHEN lowers AND NOT sec.workspace_is_personal(ws) THEN 'open' ELSE 'applied' END, me);
IF lowers AND NOT sec.workspace_is_personal(ws) THEN
decision := gov._open_decision('elevation', new_id, me, me, 'elevation', sec.args_hash(p_changes),
'Lower the class of operations in the catalogue.', true, 'person', NULL);
UPDATE app.operation_changes SET decision_id = decision WHERE workspace_id = ws AND id = new_id;
-- A person completes a pairing link in their own session: the channel account becomes theirs.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.complete_pairing(p_link_hash text) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT * INTO i FROM app.channel_identities x WHERE x.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND x.link_hash = p_link_hash AND x.person_id IS NULL;
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such pairing link';
UPDATE app.channel_identities SET person_id = me, paired_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND id = i.id;
-- The run's current holder completes a pending step, whichever fence wrote it. Returns how many
-- steps it completed: none for a session that does not hold the run.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.complete_step(p_run uuid, p_seq integer, p_output jsonb) RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
IF sec.current_run() IS DISTINCT FROM p_run THEN
UPDATE app.run_steps SET output = coalesce(p_output, '{}'), status = 'done', completed_at = clock_timestamp()
WHERE workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND run_id = p_run AND seq = p_seq AND status = 'pending';
-- A person creates an agent. A worker is its creator's; a verifier belongs to the workspace (its
-- system principal) and only an owner or admin creates one. Guests create none.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.create_agent(p_name text, p_role text) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
IF p_role IS NULL OR p_role NOT IN ('worker', 'verifier') THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: an agent is a worker or a verifier';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'role: a guest creates no agents';
IF p_role = 'verifier' AND NOT sec.is_admin(me) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'role: only an owner or an admin creates a verifier';
owner := CASE p_role WHEN 'verifier' THEN sec.system_principal() ELSE me END;
INSERT INTO app.principals (workspace_id, id, kind, agent_role, owner_id, name)
PERFORM gov._append('agent.created', new_id::text, jsonb_build_object('role', p_role, 'owner', owner));
-- A person writes a new document: a workspace document, or one in a task they can see.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.create_document(p_task uuid, p_title text, p_content text, p_by uuid, p_workspace uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
IF p_workspace IS NOT NULL AND p_workspace IS DISTINCT FROM sec.current_workspace() THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'denied: the document names another workspace than the session''s';
IF p_by IS NOT NULL AND p_by IS DISTINCT FROM me THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'denied: a person writes only as themself';
IF p_task IS NOT NULL AND NOT sec.task_visible(p_task) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such task for this person';
INSERT INTO app.documents (workspace_id, id, task_id, title, content, updated_by, content_author)
VALUES (sec.current_workspace(), new_id, p_task, coalesce(p_title, 'Untitled'), coalesce(p_content, ''), me, me);
-- A person sets a routine for one of their own workers: its own private task, and a root mandate for
-- its firings. An instruction routine holds the person's instruction in its task. Its firings are
-- direct work, carried by the installation's own scheduler and worker, never by a piece.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.create_routine(p_agent uuid, p_kind text, p_title text, p_instruction text, p_schedule text, p_timezone text,
p_ceiling smallint, p_expires_at timestamptz) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM app.principals p WHERE p.workspace_id = ws AND p.id = p_agent AND p.kind = 'agent'

mandate := gov.issue_mandate(p_agent, NULL, '"*"', '"*"', '"*"', '"*"', coalesce(p_ceiling, 4::smallint), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
INSERT INTO app.routines (workspace_id, id, person_id, agent_id, task_id, mandate_id, kind, title, instruction, schedule, timezone)
VALUES (ws, new_id, me, p_agent, task, mandate, kind, coalesce(p_title, 'Routine'),
CASE WHEN kind = 'instruction' THEN p_instruction END, p_schedule, p_timezone);
PERFORM gov._append('routine.created', new_id::text, jsonb_build_object('kind', kind, 'task', task, 'mandate', mandate,
-- A person files a task of their own; the system principal files one for a person. Private unless
-- stated otherwise. A row may not name another workspace, nor point at another workspace's people.
p_requested_by uuid, p_on_behalf_of uuid, p_title text, p_goal text, p_visibility text, p_kind text DEFAULT 'task',
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
IF p_workspace IS NOT NULL AND p_workspace IS DISTINCT FROM ws THEN

-- The service creates an installation's first workspace, from an empty session; every later one is
CREATE FUNCTION gov.create_workspace(p_name text, p_kind text, p_owner_name text, p_owner_email text)
RETURNS TABLE (workspace_id uuid, owner_id uuid, system_id uuid)
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog

-- A person accepts an imported memory (then it is their memory, in their words) or declines it.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.decide_memory_proposal(p_proposal uuid, p_accept boolean) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT * INTO p FROM app.memory_proposals x WHERE x.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND x.id = p_proposal AND x.status = 'open';
IF NOT FOUND OR p.person_id <> me THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such open proposal of this person';

-- A verifier hands a question on to people, once, saying why. The question stays open, leaves the
-- verification queue, and its note stays with the question: the ledger records only its digest.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.escalate_decision(p_decision uuid, p_note text) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
IF me IS NULL OR NOT sec.is_verifier(me) OR sec.names_run() THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'role: only a verifier escalates a question';
SELECT * INTO d FROM app.decisions x WHERE x.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND x.id = p_decision FOR UPDATE;
IF NOT FOUND OR d.status <> 'open' OR d.escalated_at IS NOT NULL THEN

WHERE workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND id = p_decision;

-- The holder of a running run finishes it.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.finish_run(p_run uuid, p_fence bigint, p_outcome text) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale: the run is no longer running';
IF p_outcome IS NULL OR p_outcome NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed') THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: a run finishes succeeded or failed';

-- A person forgets one of their memories: the words are erased, for good.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.forget_memory(p_memory uuid) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_identity: the session acts as nobody';
SELECT * INTO m FROM app.memory WHERE workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND id = p_memory AND forgotten_at IS NULL;
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such memory to forget';
IF sec.names_run() OR m.owner_id <> me THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'someone_else: only its person forgets a memory';

CREATE FUNCTION gov.import_material(p_person uuid, p_source text, p_material jsonb) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog

RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: material is imported for a person of this workspace';
INSERT INTO app.tasks (workspace_id, id, title, visibility, kind, requested_by, on_behalf_of)
VALUES (ws, task, 'Imported from ' || gov._source_name(source), 'private', 'import', p_person, p_person);
FOR x IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_material -> 'documents', '[]')) LOOP
INSERT INTO app.documents (workspace_id, task_id, title, content, updated_by, content_author, imported)
VALUES (ws, task, coalesce(x ->> 'title', 'Imported'), coalesce(x ->> 'content', ''), me, me, true);
FOR x IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_material -> 'memories', '[]')) LOOP
INSERT INTO app.memory_proposals (workspace_id, person_id, source, content, path, line)

-- cannot tell is UNKNOWN: never success, never resent, and given at once a named resolver (the
-- person the effect was for), its evidence (the observation hash) and a deadline 24 hours on
-- (I-6). The one exception to "observed once" is a late observation of a swept dispatch.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.observe_effect(p_effect uuid, p_claim text, p_outcome text, p_external_ref text, p_observation_hash text, p_note text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog
SELECT * INTO e FROM app.effects x WHERE x.workspace_id = sec.current_workspace() AND x.id = p_effect FOR UPDATE;
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such effect in this workspace';
SELECT * INTO q FROM ops.effect_queue x WHERE x.effect_id = p_effect;
-- A late observation: the sweep recorded this dispatch UNKNOWN after its claim lapsed
-- (gov.settle_lapsed_dispatch), and the dispatcher that held that claim now knows what came of it.
-- It may settle it once, as succeeded or failed, never resend. Its claim is checked by hash.
IF e.status = 'unknown' AND e.swept_claim_hash IS NOT NULL THEN
IF e.swept_claim_hash IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(p_claim, ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex') THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale: this claim did not begin the dispatch';
IF p_outcome IS NULL OR p_outcome NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed') THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: a late observation settles as succeeded or failed';
UPDATE app.effects SET status = p_outcome, external_ref = coalesce(p_external_ref, external_ref), observation_hash = p_observation_hash,
note = p_note, settled_by = sec.current_principal(), swept_claim_hash = NULL
WHERE workspace_id = e.workspace_id AND id = p_effect;
IF e.status <> 'dispatching' OR q.claim_token IS DISTINCT FROM p_claim THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale: this claim did not begin the dispatch';
IF p_outcome IS NULL OR p_outcome NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'unknown') THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: an outcome is succeeded, failed or unknown';
resolver := coalesce(e.on_behalf_of_id, (SELECT p.id FROM app.principals p WHERE p.workspace_id = e.workspace_id
AND p.kind = 'person' AND p.role = 'owner' ORDER BY p.created_at LIMIT 1));

resolver_id = resolver, resolve_by = CASE WHEN p_outcome = 'unknown' THEN clock_timestamp() + interval '24 hours' END
WHERE workspace_id = e.workspace_id AND id = p_effect;
DELETE FROM ops.effect_queue x WHERE x.effect_id = p_effect;

-- in its sources, and what an agent wrote (or the proposer itself) is not evidence. One question
-- is opened, for a checker independent of the proposer's whole delegation tree (I-9): the
-- verifier, or without one any independent owner or admin. The same proposal already rejected is
CREATE FUNCTION gov.request_promotion(p_candidate uuid, p_owner uuid, p_valid_from timestamptz, p_valid_to timestamptz) RETURNS uuid

RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_identity: the session acts as nobody';
SELECT * INTO c FROM app.knowledge_candidates x WHERE x.workspace_id = ws AND x.id = p_candidate FOR UPDATE;
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found: no such candidate in this workspace';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'denied: promotion is requested by the candidate''s proposer';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_open: the candidate is closed';
SELECT * INTO owner FROM app.principals p WHERE p.workspace_id = ws AND p.id = p_owner;
IF NOT FOUND OR owner.kind <> 'person' OR owner.role NOT IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member') OR owner.status <> 'active' THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_member: knowledge is owned by a member of the workspace';
-- Preserve the established invalid/self-evidence refusal before the temporary source pause.
FOR ev IN SELECT x ->> 'excerpt' AS excerpt, e.* FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.evidence) x
JOIN app.episodes e ON e.workspace_id = ws AND e.id::text = x ->> 'episode' LOOP
IF ev.excerpt IS NULL OR length(ev.excerpt) = 0 OR position(ev.excerpt IN ev.content) = 0 THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_verbatim: the evidence is not found verbatim in its source';

RAISE EXCEPTION 'self_evidence: what an agent wrote, or what the proposer wrote, is not evidence';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'paused: promotion awaits source withdrawal verification';
IF c.terms_hash IS NOT NULL THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen: the candidate''s terms were set by its first request';
RAISE EXCEPTION 'conflict: there is already an open question about this candidate';
IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM app.knowledge_candidates x WHERE x.workspace_id = ws AND x.status = 'rejected' AND x.terms_hash = terms) THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'already_rejected: the same proposal was already rejected';
UPDATE app.knowledge_candidates SET owner_id = p_owner, valid_from = p_valid_from, valid_to = p_valid_to, terms_hash = terms
WHERE workspace_id = ws AND id = p_candidate;

question := question || ' The work that proposed it read untrusted content and private material: only '
|| (SELECT p.name FROM app.principals p WHERE p.workspace_id = ws AND p.id = c.on_behalf_of) || ' and the verifier see it.';
RETURN gov._open_decision('promotion', p_candidate, me, c.on_behalf_of, CASE WHEN c.kept THEN 'rule_of_two' ELSE 'promotion' END,
terms, question, true, kind, CASE WHEN c.kept THEN c.on_behalf_of END);

-- A run's lease or status says nothing here. Returns 'live' (left alone), 'succeeded' (the
-- inspection found it landed) or 'unknown' (with its resolver and deadline, I-6). The
-- closed claim's hash is kept: a late observation under it may still settle the UNKNOWN.
CREATE FUNCTION gov.settle_lapsed_dispatch(p_effect uuid, p_claim text, p_landed boolean, p_observation_hash text, p_note text)

SELECT * INTO q FROM ops.effect_queue x WHERE x.effect_id = p_effect FOR UPDATE;

RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale: this claim does not hold a dispatch in flight';
IF p_landed IS NULL OR p_observation_hash IS NULL THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid: a settlement states whether it landed and its evidence';
IF q.lease_expires_at + grace > clock_timestamp() OR (q.stale_handed_until IS NOT NULL AND q.stale_handed_until > clock_timestamp()) THEN

AND p.kind = 'person' AND p.role = 'owner' ORDER BY p.created_at LIMIT 1));
